roundEnd.question: What ends a share dealing round?
roundEnd.answer: Each player consecutively not making a purchase or a sale. The priority then goes to the player who has bid highest for it, or remains with the same player if no bids.

miscellaneous.question: Miscellaneous
miscellaneous.answer: A share's value depends on its terrain, not the nation (company) it belongs to. The canal network is drawn onto the board rather than laying tiles. The cards that time phases are used for both digging team (trains) and waterworks (~= station markers). There is a single rainy season (operating round) for all players, company income being determined by owner of last waterwork in an irrigation chain. Game ends when all water entering system is used (or at prior bankruptcy).
